fullPassage: In consultative selling, one acts as a consultant offering solutions to clients for their problems rather than simply trying to push products or services. As a result, forging personal relationships based on trust and a natural rapport is key, and one skill important for this task is establishing appropriate eye contact. Research shows that eye contact can strengthen bonds with others, a critical factor in building the trust needed in consultative sales. Maintaining good eye contact communicates that one is both honest and engaged, listening to the others’ concerns and wanting to offer assistance in fixing them. However, as with all forms of nonverbal communication, one must always take cues from others to avoid mistakes when looking into their eyes. Prolonged, unbroken stares can make people uncomfortable and even be considered rude in some cultures.

③ (A) 핵심 (B) 열쇠: 신뢰가 관계 형성의 '핵심' + 문을 여는 '열쇠' ←정답

④ (A) 실마리 (B) 핵심: (A)는 '핵심', (B)는 '열쇠'예요

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a signal, hint, or action that tells someone it is time to do or say something"

det.korean: bond=유대 / stare=응시 / client=고객 / cue=단서, 신호
det.analysis:
① bond: 유대 — 사람 사이의 끈이라 정의와 달라요

② stare: 응시 — 빤히 봄이라 '신호'가 아니에요

③ client: 고객 — 사람이라 무관해요

④ cue: 어떤 행동·말을 할 때임을 알려 주는 '신호, 단서' ←정답
det.tip: a signal or hint that tells someone to act → 단서(cue).

questions.passage: Maintaining good eye contact communicates that one is both honest and engaged, __________ (listen) to the others' concerns and wanting to offer assistance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: listen → listening: 뒤의 wanting과 and로 묶이는 분사구문이라 현재분사(-ing)로 바꿔요.
det.analysis:
'~ honest and engaged, __________ to the others' concerns and wanting to offer assistance'에서 빈칸은 뒤의 wanting(현재분사)과 and로 병렬되는 분사구문 자리예요.

→ 따라서 listen을 현재분사 listening으로 써요.
det.tip: listening ~ and wanting ~ : 분사 병렬 (-ing).

questions.passage: Research shows that eye contact can strengthen bonds with others, a critical factor in building the trust __________ (need) in consultative sales.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: need → needed: 'the trust (that is) ______'로 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 과거분사(p.p.)로 바꿔요.
det.analysis:
'building the trust __________ in consultative sales'에서 빈칸은 the trust(그 신뢰)를 뒤에서 수식하는 자리예요. 신뢰가 '필요해지는(요구되는)' 수동 의미이니 need를 과거분사 needed로 바꿔요. (the trust which is needed에서 which is 생략)

→ 따라서 need를 needed로 써요.
det.tip: the trust (which is) needed = 필요한 신뢰 (과거분사 후치수식).

questions.passage: In consultative selling, one acts as a consultant offering solutions to clients for their problems rather than simply trying to push products or services. As a result, forging personal relationships based on trust and a natural rapport is key, and one skill important for this task is establishing appropriate eye contact. Research shows that eye contact can strengthen bonds with others, a critical factor in building the trust needed in consultative sales. Maintaining good eye contact communicates that one is both honest and engaged, listening to the others’ concerns and wanting to offer assistance in fixing them. However, as with all forms of __________, one must always take cues from others to avoid mistakes when looking into their eyes. Prolonged, unbroken stares can make people uncomfortable and even be considered rude in some cultures.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: nonverbal communication=비언어적 의사소통 / verbal persuasion=언어적 설득 / written agreements=서면 합의 / financial rewards=금전적 보상
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤 'one must always take cues from others ~ when looking into their eyes(눈을 마주칠 때 단서를 읽어야 한다)'가 단서예요. 아이컨택은 말이 아닌 소통 방식이에요.

① nonverbal communication: 아이컨택은 '비언어적 의사소통'의 한 형태예요 ←정답

② verbal persuasion: 언어적 설득은 눈 맞춤과 안 맞아요

③ written agreements: 서면 합의는 문맥과 무관해요

④ financial rewards: 금전적 보상은 문맥에 안 맞아요
det.tip: all forms of ______ ~ looking into their eyes → 비언어적 의사소통.

questions.passage: In consultative selling, one acts as a consultant offering solutions to clients for their problems rather than simply trying to push products or services. As a result, forging personal relationships based on trust and a natural rapport is key, and one skill important for this task is establishing appropriate eye contact. Research shows that eye contact can strengthen bonds with others, a critical factor in building the trust needed in consultative sales. Maintaining good eye contact communicates that one is both honest and engaged, listening to the others’ concerns and wanting to offer assistance in fixing them. However, as with all forms of nonverbal communication, one must always __________ to avoid mistakes when looking into their eyes. Prolonged, unbroken stares can make people uncomfortable and even be considered rude in some cultures.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: speak much more loudly=훨씬 크게 말하다 / take cues from others=다른 사람에게서 단서를 얻다 / ignore all their reactions=그들의 반응을 무시하다 / end the conversation early=대화를 일찍 끝내다
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞뒤 'one must always ______ to avoid mistakes when looking into their eyes(눈을 마주칠 때 실수를 피하려면 항상 ______해야 한다)'가 단서예요.

① speak much more loudly: 크게 말하기는 비언어적 단서 읽기와 무관해요

② take cues from others: 실수를 피하려면 상대의 '단서를 읽어야' 해요 ←정답

③ ignore all their reactions: 반응 무시는 단서를 읽어야 한다는 흐름과 반대예요

④ end the conversation early: 대화를 끝내는 것은 문맥에 안 맞아요
det.tip: to avoid mistakes → 상대에게서 단서를 얻다(take cues from others).
